== Acquisition ==
* [[Kurzick Bureaucrat]] ([[House zu Heltzer]] and [[Kurzick]]-allied [[guild hall]]s)
* [[Luxon Scavenger]] ([[Cavalon]] and [[Luxon]]-allied guild halls)

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Dual Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Forked Arrow}}

== Notes ==
* After reaching the first [[allegiance rank]], Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, [[level]] 20 [[character]]s may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The [[skill icon]] for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* Bonus damage (i.e. from [[Conjure spell]]s, [[Glass Arrows]] and certain [[weapon spell]]s) is not reduced.
* Even with the large damage reduction per arrow at rank 1, Triple Shot will still do more damage than [[Dual Shot]] under normal circumstances.
{{bug|The base attack damage from this skill is [[Talk:Triple Shot#Worse than advertised?|50...35% less damage]] rather than the 40...25% stated.}}

== Trivia ==
*This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
